newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Purefoods gets tax incentives for projects.
newsitem.headline: Purefoods gets tax incentives for projects.

text.p: The Philippine Board of Investments (BOI) has approved tax and fiscal incentives to the 376.23-million peso livestock expansion programme of Purefoods Corp.
Documents from the BOI showed Purefoods, the food manufacturing arm of Philippine conglomerate Ayala Corp, plans to set up two livestock farms in the country.
These include a livestock farm with a capacity of 1,000 pigs in Bulacan north of Manila and another breeding farm with a capacity of 4,000 pigs on the southern Bukidnon island.
The BOI said it has granted a three-year income tax holiday on Purefoods' Bulacan project and four years on the firm's proposed Bukidnon farm.
The government also waived duties on the import of capital equipment for both projects.
One of the tasks of the BOI is to give tax and duty incentives to priority investment projects in the country.
